About this range

Boxed sets solve the two things gift and promotional buyers complain about most: artworking the pack and getting a coherent assortment. These kits ship in moulded cases and colour boxes with matched accessories — corkscrew, foil cutter, stopper, pourer, drop stop — in black or wood-finish handles, ready for a logo on the case or the tool. They are the fastest route to a sellable gift SKU without building a pack from components.

Bar Sets &amp; Gift Kits — buyer questions

MOQ is held per SKU/model and per order route for this range — a standard bulk order, a decorated order and a gift-box build can each carry a different minimum.

What does the Bar Sets & Gift Kits range include?

This range holds 4 items, specified in ABS, wood and metal. Orders come most often from gift and corporate programmes, promotional distributors and retail and e-commerce brands. Each product card states the shape, capacity, material and case pack for that SKU, and the specification table on each product page is the record the quotation is issued against.

See the range · Request a quote

What can be included in a custom barware gift set?

A gift set is quoted as a complete build: the items, the insert, the gift box, the logo treatment, the outer carton and the quantity. Send the full composition rather than individual items.

Gift box packaging guide

What is the MOQ for a gift set?

MOQ is maintained per SKU and per build. A gift-set build normally has a different minimum from the standard bulk order for the same item, so the confirmed figure is issued with the quotation.

How MOQ works

Can the gift box itself be branded?

Yes, subject to confirmation of the box material, print method, colour count and quantity. Provide the artwork and the intended box format.

Custom branding

How is the set protected for export?

The insert, box and outer carton are specified so the set arrives intact. Confirm the destination and the required shipping protection in the quotation request.

Wholesale programme

Can I mix items from different categories in one set?

Yes. Submit the complete item list, quantities and packaging requirement. Mixed-category sets are quoted as one build and consolidated into a single shipment.

Request a quote
